cases.question: Brief me on the Bronx in February 2026

runs.text: Bronx recorded 150 complaints in Feb 2026, the same as in Feb 2025 and the same as in Jan 2026. The most common types were HEAT/HOT WATER (100) and Illegal Parking (50). That is 10.2 complaints per 100,000 residents. These are recorded complaints, which reflect who reports as well as the conditions themselves.
